title: Avoid a near-touch at the frame
alt_text: Two crop studies of a mug and book compare a book corner that almost touches the frame, leaving a narrow confusing sliver, with a roomier crop that gives the corner a clear margin.
caption: A tiny accidental gap can make the frame edge compete with the object.
